title: Utah Mighty 5 Trip Pack, Road Trip Itinerary + 10 Best Hikes GPX Routes, Zion Bryce Arches Travel Guide PDF, National Parks Planner
description:
Everything for a Utah national parks road trip in one download: the Trip Planning Guide to plan it, and the 10 Best Day Hikes GPX Route Collection to walk it. $19.99 instead of $24.98 bought separately.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Trip Planning Guide: seasons and road access, getting there, park fees, where to stay, 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries, beyond hiking, safety, packing list and trip planner
- 11 GPX route files: Canyon Overlook, Emerald Pools, The Narrows (plus a Big Spring extension), Navajo Loop and Queen's Garden, Fairyland Loop, Delicate Arch, The Windows and Double Arch, Mesa Arch, Hickman Bridge and Cassidy Arch
- Route guide with photos, maps, elevation profiles and a fillable trail passport
- 10 trail badges plus a shareable story image for every hike

WHAT YOU GET
- Guides in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition
- GPX files for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or a GPS watch
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
The itineraries are numbered to match the GPX files. Trail data from the National Park Service and OpenStreetMap contributors; photos via Wikimedia Commons with credits. Desert heat and flash floods are real: check the forecast and park pages. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
sub: The road trip guide plus 10 day-hike GPS routes across all five parks, a passport and badges.
